lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance clusters are organized in approximately 10 identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-rectilinear grid along the lateral midline where local maxima are spaced at roughly regular intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs to form approximately 40 distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity values on the superior edge and low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs are distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial density observed toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-toned, fusiform biological entity (remora) is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region below the mid-body ridge.
